## Summary

What changed?

## Why

Why is this change needed? Link a relevant issue if there is one.

## How verified

List commands and manual checks with their results. Include failures and checks not run, with reasons; do not imply the application suite passed without running it.

## Checklist

- [ ] This is a focused change targeting `master`, with relevant tests and documentation updated.
- [ ] The title uses an allowed Conventional Commits type and describes the squash commit.
- [ ] I reported verification accurately, including failures and limitations.
- [ ] No secrets, real credentials, pairing codes, personal information, desktop captures, or real daemon data are included in the diff or evidence; any test-interface images use synthetic data and were inspected for sensitive content.
- [ ] I understand that external contributions need @j-carv's approval and that new commits require renewed approval.
